name: How does a condensation assessment differ from a standard commercial building inspection?
description: A condensation assessment focuses specifically on dew points, insulation integrity, and airflow dynamics rather than a broad overview of general building codes

mainEntity.name: How does a condensation assessment differ from a standard commercial building inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Condensation assessments focus strictly on thermal dynamics, dew-point calculation, insulation continuity, and ventilation rates. General building inspections, by contrast, briefly review overall code compliance, electrical, plumbing, and structural components without detailed moisture-origin analysis. If you only hire a general inspector, you risk receiving a note that moisture exists without the building-envelope remediation details required to resolve it permanently.
acceptedAnswer.description: A condensation assessment focuses specifically on dew points, insulation integrity, and airflow dynamics rather than a broad overview of general building codes and utilities.
